children: Kingfisher's profits in the first half were strong and better than expected in all regions, RBC Capital Markets analysts say in a note. The home-improvement retailer's adjusted profit before taxes was well ahead of consensus, and even allowed for a 14 million-pound business rates refund in the U.K., the analysts say. The company also upgraded its guidance. Shares open flat at 305.7 pence. (aimee.look@wsj.com)
